## 1. FDY-GEM-03 · Foundry: prior art for each of the 11 inventions

**Due:** 2026-11-23 · **State:** delivered 2026-11-18, waiting for its check: do not redo it unless a review reopens it

**Why:** Owner, 2026-11-16: homework that is legit (it changes what the pillar can do) and detailed enough that it cannot be done wrong.

**What it unlocks:** Foundry shows, on each build, what already exists, so Joseph builds what is new.

**Read first:**
- https://jpavia10.github.io/prometheus-hub/pillars/foundry/
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpavia10/prometheus-hub/main/AI_START_HERE.md

**Do this:**
1. Read the 11 inventions in pillars/foundry (repo); five per invention, closest first.

**Make:** `foundry_gemini_prior-art_{YYYYMMDD-HHMM}.json`

**Save in:** Prometheus Hub/Pillars/Prometheus Hub/incoming (AI drop files)/

**Shape:** `JSON array, one object per row, exactly the fields below and nothing else`

**Every field, exactly:**
- `invention` (text): the invention's title as in pillars/foundry
- `n` (1-5): rank within the invention
- `what` (text): patent or product name
- `owner` (text): company or inventor
- `year` (integer): filed or launched
- `link` (URL): Google Patents page or the product's own page
- `how_close` (text): one sentence: what it shares and what it does not

**One finished row, as an example (use your own data, never copy this):**

```
{
 "invention": "...",
 "n": 1,
 "what": "US 10,000,000 B2 ...",
 "owner": "...",
 "year": 2019,
 "link": "https://patents.google.com/...",
 "how_close": "..."
}
```

**Before you save, check every one of these yourself:**
- [ ] Every row has a URL you opened yourself today, on the maker's or agency's own site (not a blog, forum, wiki or AI summary).
- [ ] Every quote is copied word for word from that page and is on it now.
- [ ] No row is a copy of another with the names changed.
- [ ] Numbers have their unit in the field name or the unit field, never inside the text.
- [ ] The file is valid JSON (or the exact markdown headings asked for) and is named exactly as asked.

**How many:** 55

**Done when:** 55 rows exactly in the shape, every self-check line true.

**How Claude checks it:**
- Claude opens 10 rows (or 10 claims) at random and compares them with their source.

**Not done (sent back) if:**
- fewer rows than the count, or a row missing a field
- a row copied from another row with the names changed
- a URL that does not open, is a front page or a search page, or does not say what the row claims
- a quote that is not on the page it cites (Claude opens 10 rows at random)
- a file saved anywhere but the folder named here, or under another name
- a guess written as a fact (say 'not found' instead)
- anything about Joseph's own accounts, balances, mail or records beyond what the task names

## 2. FDY-GEM-06 · Foundry: the power budget for each stage-1 build, from the parts' datasheets

**Due:** 2026-12-06 · **State:** now

**Why:** A parts list is only buildable when the power adds up.

**What it unlocks:** Each invention's stage 1 shows the supply it needs.

**Read first:**
- Gemini's file foundry_gemini_stage1-parts_20261121-1300.json
- Each part's datasheet on Pololu or Adafruit

**Do this:**
1. For each part that draws power: voltage and the peak current from its datasheet.
2. Per invention: add the peak currents (show the math) and name a supply in the list that covers it with 25 % margin, or say none does.

**Make:** `foundry_gemini_power-budget_{YYYYMMDD-HHMM}.json`

**Save in:** Prometheus Hub/Pillars/Prometheus Hub/incoming (AI drop files)/

**Shape:** `JSON array, one object per row, exactly the fields below`

**Every field, exactly:**
- `n` (number): 1, 2, 3 ...
- `invention` (text): as in the parts file
- `part` (text): as in the parts file
- `volts` (number): V
- `peak_amps` (number): A
- `math` (text): the sum, for the total rows
- `url` (url): the page you opened, on the official site
- `quote` (text): copied word for word from that page, 300 characters at most

**Before you save, check every one of these yourself:**
- [ ] Every row has a URL you opened yourself today, on the maker's, agency's or store's own site (never a blog, forum, wiki, reseller, or AI summary).
- [ ] Every quote is copied word for word from that page or PDF page and is there now.
- [ ] Every number has its unit in its own field; anything worked out shows its arithmetic in the field that says 'math'.
- [ ] No row is a copy of another with the names changed.
- [ ] The file is valid JSON (or exactly the Markdown asked for) and is named exactly as asked.

**Done when:** Every powered part has a row; every invention has a total row.

**How Claude checks it:**
- Claude opens 12 rows at random against their pages and redoes every 'math' field.

**Not done (sent back) if:**
- fewer rows than the count, or a row missing a field
- a URL that does not open, is a home page or a search page, or does not say what the row claims
- a quote that is not on the page it cites (Claude opens rows at random)
- arithmetic that does not add up when Claude redoes it
- a file saved anywhere but the folder named here, or under another name
- a guess written as a fact (write 'not stated' and name the page you checked)
